description: This file contains functions and types related to conversation condensing, message summarization, and message history management in a chat application, specifically handling tool result blocks, reasoning blocks, and message tagging for context management.

methods.name: hasToolResultBlocks
methods.description: Checks if a message contains tool_result blocks, which are used in native tools protocol to link user messages with previous assistant tool_use blocks.

methods.name: getToolUseBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves all tool_use blocks from a message if the message is from the assistant.

methods.name: getToolResultBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves all tool_result blocks from a message if the message is from the user.

methods.name: findToolUseBlockById
methods.description: Finds a specific tool_use block by ID within a message.

methods.name: getReasoningBlocks
methods.description: Extracts reasoning blocks from a message's content array.

methods.name: getKeepMessagesWithToolBlocks
methods.description: Extracts messages to keep along with associated tool_use and reasoning blocks, searching backwards for matching tool_use blocks based on tool_result blocks.

methods.name: getMessagesSinceLastSummary
methods.description: Returns all messages since the last summary message, including the last summary itself.

methods.name: getEffectiveApiHistory
methods.description: Filters the full message history to exclude messages that have been condensed or truncated, based on parent references.

methods.name: cleanupAfterTruncation
methods.description: Removes orphaned condenseParent and truncationParent references after truncation operations to restore message consistency.

methods.name: summarizeConversation
methods.description: Asynchronously summarizes the conversation using an LLM, handling message tagging, context management, and synthetic reasoning blocks for deep reasoning compatibility.
